modality_separation_rule: Modalities (xray, bone_scan, ct) are strictly separated at acquisition, ingestion, validation, splitting, and model training. Modalities are never assumed interchangeable.

metastasis.title: Secondary Bone Metastasis Acquisition Protocol

modality_specific_notes.xray: Focal osteolytic, osteoblastic, or mixed cortical/medullary lesions on native >=1024x1024 CR/DR DICOM.
modality_specific_notes.bone_scan: Whole-body paired Anterior + Posterior 99mTc-MDP planar scintigraphy bound atomically by patient_id.
modality_specific_notes.ct: Helical bone-window CT series (slice thickness <= 1.5 mm) with 3D lesion/vertebra segmentation where applicable.

HISTOPATHOLOGY_CONFIRMED.description: Core needle biopsy or surgical excision confirming extra-skeletal primary carcinoma metastasis.

RADIOLOGY_AND_CLINICAL_CONCORDANCE.description: Multimodal PET-CT/MRI/radiology concordance + documented primary malignancy and follow-up course; tracked separately from biopsy-confirmed cases.

explicit_exclusions: Primary malignant bone sarcomas (osteosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, chondrosarcoma, BTXRD Class 2)
Hematologic bone marrow malignancies (multiple myeloma, plasmacytoma) unless segregated
Unconfirmed primary malignancy or indeterminate suspicious lesions
BTXRD Center 2 (N=549) and Center 3 (N=259) protected external holdouts

paget.title: Paget's Disease of Bone Acquisition Protocol

modality_specific_notes.xray: Primary imaging pathway: Pelvis AP, lumbar/thoracic spine AP/Lat, femur, skull, tibia (>=1024x1024 DICOM 12/16-bit).
modality_specific_notes.bone_scan: 99mTc-MDP intense uniform geometric uptake along involved bone contour (paired Ant/Post).
modality_specific_notes.ct: Corroborative bone-window CT demonstrating cortical thickening and trabecular coarsening.

clinical_radiological_triad: Cortical thickening with endosteal margin blurring
confirmation_requirements.biochemical_corroboration: Elevated serum total alkaline phosphatase (ALP) or bone-specific ALP (BSAP) with normal serum calcium/phosphate.

explicit_exclusions: Fibrous dysplasia, osteopetrosis, chronic osteomyelitis, hyperparathyroidism brown tumors
Blastic skeletal metastases mimicking Paget's (e.g. prostate carcinoma)
Educational web scraping (Radiopaedia, MedPix, compressed 8-bit annotated teaching figures)

oi.title: Osteogenesis Imperfecta (Human Clinical) Acquisition Protocol

modality_specific_notes.xray: Primary imaging pathway: Bilateral long-bone (femur, tibia, humerus, forearm), pelvis, spine, skull radiographs; pediatric growth-plate maturation status documented.
modality_specific_notes.ct: Dedicated human clinical CT when clinically indicated; non-human micro-CT permanently prohibited.

GENETIC_CONFIRMED.description: Pathogenic/likely pathogenic COL1A1, COL1A2, or recessive OI locus variant verified via targeted panel/WES.

CLINICAL_RADIOLOGICAL_SILLENCE.description: Pediatric endocrinologist/geneticist/orthopedist Sillence phenotypic confirmation + cortical thinning, osteopenia, bowing, Wormian bones.

pediatric_ethics_requirements.note: Pediatric cohorts (age < 18) require vulnerable-subject ethics clearance, guardian consent / minor assent or formal IEC waiver, and age/growth-plate matched controls.

explicit_exclusions: Non-human animal imaging and murine micro-CT (e.g. Figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.c.3795019 oim mouse tibiae)
Post-menopausal, senile, disuse, or idiopathic osteoporosis and osteopenia
Perinatal lethal Type II neonatal imaging unless dedicated age-stratified sub-study approved

healthy.title: Healthy Skeletal Control Acquisition Protocol

modality_specific_notes.xray: Asymptomatic normal plain radiographs matched across upper extremities, pelvis, spine, femur/tibia, and skull (Stanford MURA restricted to upper extremity ONLY).
modality_specific_notes.bone_scan: Physiological normal 99mTc-MDP tracer distribution without active malignancy (never breast cancer staging negatives).
modality_specific_notes.ct: Asymptomatic normal bone-window skeletal CT series.

eligibility_requirements.age_sex_matching_note: Include pediatric growth-plate controls for OI and >=50y adult controls for Paget/Metastasis to avoid anatomical or age shortcut learning.

explicit_exclusions: Contralateral, fellow, or unaffected limbs of fracture, trauma, or oncology patients
Healthy status inferred merely from absence of fracture or missing diagnosis (e.g. FracAtlas non-fractured)
Active oncology staging patients with negative metastasis scan (e.g. IICS-UNA staging negative cohort)
Significant osteopenia/osteoporosis, orthopaedic implants, or severe degenerative osteoarthritis
